openings.claim: Speculatively, beyond row-ID replacement alone, a provenance graph on immutable occurrences carrying explicit supersession edges, status meanings and cutoff eligibility may recognize already represented retroactive corrections across changed identifiers, preventing double application while preserving every occurrence. Normalized-quantity matches suggest aliases; they never establish identity.
openings.discriminator: Where explicit records uniquely establish cross-report representation, the graph should reconcile the awkward amendment; literal superseded-row lookup using the same occurrence ledger should retain disagreement when identifiers cannot establish representation. Removing a needed edge or introducing undefined status should withdraw affected definite conclusions. Identical behavior leaves capability unconfirmed; without a distinguishing case, the experiment is inconclusive. Defeat: unsupported aliases, definite quantities surviving indispensable-evidence loss, or sealed-key contradiction.
openings.probe: Within sixty minutes, run both variants on both supplied copies in script or spreadsheet; reserve ten minutes to freeze twelve batch outputs with record citations. Preserve duplicates/unmatched rows; use only supplied U=5V; never infer neighboring quantities. Output a quantity or bounded disagreement naming competing records/unknowns. Issue at most three prioritized requests naming missing fields/records; retain other disagreements. During the separate twenty-minute comparison, open the sealed key after freezing; compare resolved-batch counts, unsupported definite claims and request counts, checking whether disturbance specifically changes justified conclusions.
openings.uncertainty: Authoritative cross-report links may be absent; equality and chronology cannot supply them. Capacity is unproved; if building/checking both variants exceeds the review budget, freeze bounded disagreements. More than three independent gaps limits request coverage without authorizing invented resolution.

lineage.reason: Retains causal relation, complete test, uncertain fit and resource caveats.

decision: Enabling probe only. Establish whether supplied provenance supports identity; neither time limits nor equal quantities proves support.
